description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements a filter for logging that outputs only the message content, omitting metadata like tags or priorities. It is used in logging pipelines to simplify displayed logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that passes only log messages, skipping metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode to receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, forwarding only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the logging chain.
